title: mammillaria goodridgei f. shurliana

This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to help reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Mammillaria goodridgei f. shurliana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may help to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties.
